title: Preference learning in shades of gray: Interpretable and bias-aware reward modeling for human preferences

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distributions of character and word count differences between chosen and rejected responses, and measuring the correlation between response length and predicted reward scores.
Comparing the sentiment scores and granular tone distributions (e.g., joy, anger, sadness) across chosen and rejected responses to assess whether preference is driven by positive emotional framing.

Evaluating the frequency of politeness markers in the dataset and analyzing their correlation with human preference labels to determine if models implicitly favor polite phrasing regardless of content.
